moment_text: At 9:14 on a Tuesday, the lights go out.

moment_text: Not all of them. The kitchen first.

visual_prompt: EXTREME CLOSE-UP Style A B&W+red: a plain white refrigerator drawn in clean black line, cropped tight on the door and handle. The door is CLOSED. Small thin black sound-wave arcs beside it are crossed out with a thin red X, showing the humming has stopped. Nothing else in frame.

moment_text: and the quiet is the first thing you notice.

moment_text: You check your phone. Six missed messages.
visual_prompt: CLOSE-UP Style A B&W+red: a minimalist stick-figure hand holding a plain black rectangle, the phone. The screen shows ONLY six simple grey dots in a column, no words, no icons, no text of any kind. Dark surroundings.

moment_text: This is not your fuse box.
visual_prompt: INTERIOR CLOSE Style A B&W+red: a plain domestic electrical panel on a wall, simple black rectangle with a few simple switch shapes, all in the OFF position. A stick-figure hand reaches toward it, hesitating. B&W inkwash, minimal.

moment_text: Every window across the road is empty too,
visual_prompt: EXTERIOR WIDE Style A B&W+red: a row of four simple houses seen at night from across a street, every window completely dark. Not a single light. Clean, plain, silent. No people, no cars.

moment_text: so the problem is somewhere else,
visual_prompt: AERIAL WIDE Style A B&W+red: a flat top-down view of a whole neighbourhood of simple pitched-roof houses and straight streets, every one of them unlit, stretching to the edge of frame. One single tiny RED dot marks one house in the middle of the darkness.

moment_text: and nobody is coming to fix it tonight.
visual_prompt: EXTERIOR WIDE Style A B&W+red: an empty dark street with a single plain utility pole and overhead cables, one thin black line running off into black distance. Nobody in frame. Still and quiet.

moment_text: That is the only useful thing you will learn
visual_prompt: INTERIOR MEDIUM Style A B&W+red: the stick figure in the flat RED t-shirt stands at the dark window, seen from behind, one hand on the frame, looking out at the black street. Simple silhouette, clean line.

moment_text: in the first ten minutes: this is big.

moment_text: Here is the first clock, and it is already running.
visual_prompt: INTERIOR MEDIUM Style A B&W+red: a plain kitchen wall CLOCK, round, simple black outline, its hands drawn as clean black lines. Beside it, a thin RED arc sweeps around the dial like a countdown ring. Nothing else in frame. No numbers.

moment_text: Your fridge holds cold for about four hours
visual_prompt: EXTERIOR-STYLE CLOSE Style A B&W+red: a plain white refrigerator drawn in clean black line, doors closed, standing alone on empty white ground. A simple grey cold haze sits inside its outline.

moment_text: if you keep the door shut.

moment_text: Everyone opens the door. To look. To think.
visual_prompt: MEDIUM Style A B&W+red: the stick figure in the flat RED t-shirt stands in front of the fridge with the door OPEN, hand on the handle, staring inside. Bright cold light spills onto his face. Behind him the room is black. He is undecided.

moment_text: Every time you open it, you spend the cold.

moment_text: A full freezer is different. Forty eight hours,
visual_prompt: CLOSE-UP Style A B&W+red: a chest freezer drawn in simple black line, lid closed, packed with plain pale shapes inside shown in cross-section, dense and full. A simple grey cold aura surrounds it, thicker than the fridge's.

moment_text: The tap still runs. Notice that.

moment_text: Bottles, jugs, the bathtub, the pots.

visual_prompt: DIAGRAM STYLE Style A B&W+red: four identical plain bottle shapes standing in a neat row on white ground, each drawn with a clean black outline. Simple, graphic, countable. One bottle is tinted RED.

moment_text: that decides how the rest of the week goes.

moment_text: Your phone still works. That is temporary too.

visual_prompt: DIAGRAM STYLE Style A B&W+red: two simple phone rectangles side by side on white ground. visual_prompt: CLOSE-UP Style A B&W+red: a plain traffic light head in clean black outline, all three lamps completely dark and empty. No glow, no colour. Grey sky behind.

visual_prompt: EXTERIOR MEDIUM Style A B&W+red: a line of simple cars queued nose to tail down a plain road, drawn in clean black line, headlights drawn as simple white cones in the dark. Behind the wheel of one car, a small stick figure in a flat RED t-shirt.

moment_text: This is the last hour it will be easy,
